title: Punctured root charts descend from an ind-etale algebra
statement: Let R and H be commutative rings in one universe, g∈R, and ι:R→H an ind-etale map. Let p:Y→Spec R be affine and locally of finite presentation. Let x∈Spec H and y∈Spec R satisfy Spec(ι)(x)=y. Fix m≥0 and e:Fin m→N with all e(k)>0 and invertible in H. Suppose that Y×_R Spec H is isomorphic over Spec H to D(ι(g)) in Spec of the product of H[t]/(t^e(k)-ι(g)). Then there are a commutative ring S in the same universe, an etale map φ:R→S, and z∈Spec S with Spec(φ)(z)=y. The same e(k) are positive units in S, and Y×_R Spec S is isomorphic over Spec S to D(φ(g)) in Spec of the product of S[t]/(t^e(k)-φ(g)). The index set and exponents are retained, and the isomorphism commutes with the second projection.

proof.text: Proof: Present H as a filtered colimit of etale R-algebras S_i using ι.IndEtale. Since p is affine and locally of finite presentation, write Y=Spec B with B a finitely presented R-algebra. Each punctured product of root algebras is affine and finitely presented over its base: it is the finite product of monic polynomial quotients followed by the one-element localization at the image of g. The product, quotients, and localization commute with this filtered base change.

Use Tag 05N9 (2) to descend the coordinate maps of the given isomorphism and its inverse to a common stage. Use (3) to descend both inverse identities and the identities with the base algebra. These yield an isomorphism over Spec S_i, hence exactly the displayed projection identity after applying Spec. The finitely many units e(k) have inverses in H; descend their inverses and multiplication identities to a later common stage. The map S_i→H pulls the given point x back to a point z of Spec S_i. The cocone identity implies Spec(φ)(z)=Spec(ι)(x)=y. Every stage is etale over R. Retain the original m and e; in particular retain φ(g), rather than an unspecified associated divisor equation, in every root polynomial.

theorem punctured_root_charts_descend_indEtale
    (R H : CommRingCat.{u}) (g : R) (ι : R →+* H) (hι : ι.IndEtale)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ Spec R)
    (hp : IsAffineHom p ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation p)
    (x : Spec H) (y : Spec R) (hx : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι)) x = y)
    (m : ℕ) (e : Fin m → ℕ) (he : ∀ k, 0 < e k ∧ IsUnit (e k : H))
    (hmodel :
      let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of (∀ k : Fin m,
          AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (ι g))))
        let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap H (∀ k : Fin m,
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (ι g)))))
        let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
          (algebraMap H (∀ k : Fin m,
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (ι g))) (ι g))
        ∃ γ : pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι)) ≅ V.toScheme,
          γ.hom ≫ V.ι ≫ q = pullback.snd p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι))) :
    ∃ (S : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : R →+* S) (z : Spec S),
      Etale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) ∧
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) z = y ∧
      (∀ k, 0 < e k ∧ IsUnit (e k : S)) ∧
        let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of (∀ k : Fin m,
          AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (φ g))))
        let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap S (∀ k : Fin m,
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (φ g)))))
        let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
          (algebraMap S (∀ k : Fin m,
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (φ g))) (φ g))
        ∃ γ : pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) ≅ V.toScheme,
          γ.hom ≫ V.ι ≫ q = pullback.snd p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
